subject: Disability Fair Planning
overview: The Commission for Persons with Disabilities reviewed vendor confirmations and site tour arrangements for the upcoming Disability Fair. The commission also received an update on a proposed ordinance submitted to the City Council.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the meeting notes from the previous month.

items.title: Disability Fair Vendor and Logistics Update
items.summary: Nicholas Karinge presented an updated list of confirmed and potential vendors for the upcoming Disability Fair and discussed logistical roles for commissioners.

items.title: Disability Fair Site Visit
items.summary: An on-site tour of the school venue and playground was scheduled for April 10 at 11:00 a.m.

items.title: Fair Craft Activity Proposal
items.summary: The commission reviewed a proposal to host an assistive device decorating activity at the fair in collaboration with the Medford Public Library.

items.title: City Council Ordinance Update
items.summary: Anthony Andreottola and Nicholas Karinge reported that the City Council approved forwarding the commission's proposed ordinance to the mayor for legal review.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Guest Mark Ingram introduced himself as a disabled veteran living in Medford attending to support the commission's work.
